product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global provides freight forwarding, customs brokerage, domestic transportation and trade-compliance consulting for businesses importing, exporting and moving goods through global supply chains.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing is limited to service-specific schedules, including MGCX facility and special-service charges; it is not a company-wide subscription pricing page.

hq_location.notes: The company labels the headquarters Syracuse; its physical shipping address is in North Syracuse, New York.

eng_blog.notes: The readable indexes contain trade, logistics, regulatory, corporate and case-study content, not an engineering-authored product-development blog.

public_docs.notes: A publicly accessible GlobalLink help guide documents multiple functions, including login, user administration, tracking, shipment details, orders and reports; this is product help, not an API developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists logistics, operations, account-management and sales roles, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named AI model or provider was disclosed in the reviewed product/help material, AI-related articles or privacy policy; no dedicated AI/security FAQ or subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: Neither the privacy policy nor the published qualifications lists claims SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS certification; customs and CTPAT credentials are outside the requested set.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile states “No funding” and “has never raised funding before”; the official about page describes a family-owned and operated business. No investment round is reported.

raised_18mo.notes: No reported outside funding; reference window is 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive (Domestic 3PL) listing qualifies.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch announcement appears in the readable corporate-news history for 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09; the MGCX expansion announcement is dated 2025-12-04. The August 2026 GlobalLink customer case study describes a customized implementation, not a dated product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Senior Vice President Jeff Parker announced his retirement on 2026-03-30, within 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An Account Manager job posting explicitly states “SalesForce CRM experience preferred.”
